display_long_description:
【What is Spatial Disk?】
Spatial Disk is a new visual entertainment service that transforms past VR and 3D live performances into high-quality 3D experiences you can easily enjoy on your MetaQuest.

Like DVDs or Blu-rays, you can purchase past live shows and replay them anytime, on your favorite device.
Relive the excitement of immersive live performances—anytime, anywhere, right on your MetaQuest.

ーーー

◆Experience the Live Show “In Spacial”
Feel the depth and immersion that flat videos can’t deliver.
It’s like being there at the concert all over again.

◆One-Time Purchase, Yours Forever
Own your favorite live shows digitally—just like Blu-rays.
Enjoy them anytime without subscription or streaming limits.

◆Enjoy smooth playback, even for demanding 3D live shows.
Because the performances are pre-rendered as video, even heavy 3D content plays back smoothly.
Enjoy high-quality live shows without any lag or stress.

ーーー
